title: Guardrail Repair Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous guardrail in need of repair under emergency circumstances, i.e. rail knocked down, missing causing high fall risk, damaged metal protruding into right of way. **Freeways are the responsibility of Texas Dept of Transportation ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
instructions: Call 311 to report a hazardous guardrail requiring emergency repair, such as a knocked-down or missing rail with a high fall risk or damaged metal protruding into the right of way. This request must be dispatched. Freeway guardrails are the Texas Department of Transportation's responsibility.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone to report a hazardous guardrail that needs emergency repair.
actions.why: To report a hazardous guardrail requiring emergency repair, such as a knocked-down or missing rail creating a high fall risk, or damaged metal protruding into the right of way. The saved instructions say this request must be dispatched and reported by calling 311.
actions.why_not: This phone route does not apply to freeway guardrails, which the saved guidance identifies as the responsibility of the Texas Department of Transportation.
